ei.subject: 영어1
ei.title: Suwon Hwaseong: A Fusion of Defenses and Daily Life

fullPassage:
Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its uniqueness often goes unnoticed. This fortress artfully blends two distinct Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong.

Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with fewer soldiers. A famous example of this advantage was the battle at Haengjusanseong during the Japanese invasion of Korea in the late 16th century.

Living in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though. So during peaceful times, people lived in and around the eupseong, such as Naganeupseong and Haemieupseong. Surrounded by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. Common people, mainly farmers, lived outside these walls. In times of war, they withdrew to the nearby sanseong for safety.

After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that combined the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. Built along the natural slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong displayed strong walls and defenses while also serving as a center for agriculture, commerce, and housing.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 수원 화성은 산성과 읍성이라는 두 가지 한국 양식을 융합한 성곽이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 수원 화성은 산성과 읍성 두 양식을 결합한다: 원문 'blends two distinct Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong'과 일치
❌ ② 산성은 평지에 건설되었다: 산성은 산지 지형을 활용
❌ ③ 읍성은 높은 벽으로 둘러싸여 있었다: 원문은 low walls
❌ ④ 화성은 순수하게 군사 목적으로 건설되었다: 농업, 상업, 주거의 중심지 역할도 함

ch: ① 수원 화성은 산성과 읍성 두 양식을 결합한다.
③ 읍성은 높은 성벽으로 둘러싸여 있었다.
④ 화성은 순수하게 군사 목적으로만 건설되었다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

❌ ④ copied Western fortress construction techniques: 서양 기술 복제 언급 없음

ch: ① replaced all previous fortress designs in Korea
② integrated military defense with civilian life
③ focused exclusively on protecting against invasions

det.korean: 산성은 생활 여건이 부족했고, 읍성은 강력한 방어력이 부족했다.

det.korean: 산성은 한국의 산지 지형을 활용하여 침략자에 대한 최후의 방어 수단으로 기능했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② utilizing: 전치사 by 뒤에 동명사(V-ing)가 와야 함
❌ ① utilize: 원형 불가
❌ ③ utilized: 과거형/과거분사는 by 뒤 동명사 자리에 부적합
❌ ④ to utilize: to부정사는 by 뒤에 올 수 없음
det.tip: by + V-ing = '~함으로써'. 전치사 뒤에는 동명사가 옵니다.

det.korean: 낮은 벽으로 둘러싸인 그 지역에는 행정 건물, 학습 시설, 군사 훈련장이 있었다.

det.tip: Surrounded by ~ = '~에 둘러싸인'. 주어(the area)가 둘러싸이는 대상이므로 수동의 과거분사를 사용합니다.

det.tip: 선행사가 있고 관계절에서 주어 역할을 하므로 주격 관계대명사 that/which가 적절합니다.

questions.passage:
Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its uniqueness often goes unnoticed. This fortress artfully blends two distinct Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong.

Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with fewer soldiers. A famous example of this advantage was the battle at Haengjusanseong during the Japanese invasion of Korea in the late 16th century.

Living in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though. So during peaceful times, people lived in and around the eupseong, such as Naganeupseong and Haemieupseong. Surrounded by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. Common people, mainly farmers, lived outside these walls. In times of war, they withdrew to the nearby sanseong for safety.

After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that combined the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. Built along the natural slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong displayed strong walls and defenses while also serving as a center for agriculture, commerce, and housing.

주어진 문장: In times of war, they withdrew to the nearby sanseong for safety.

Living in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though. ( ① ) So during peaceful times, people lived in and around the eupseong, such as Naganeupseong and Haemieupseong. ( ② ) Surrounded by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. ( ③ ) Common people, mainly farmers, lived outside these walls. ( ④ )

det.korean: 주어진 문장의 'In times of war'는 앞의 평시 생활 묘사와 대비되는 전시 상황이다. 일반 백성이 성벽 밖에 살았다는 내용 뒤에 전쟁 시 산성으로 대피했다는 내용이 자연스럽게 연결된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④: '일반 백성들이 성벽 바깥에 살았다' → '전쟁 시 산성으로 철수했다'로 평시→전시 대비 흐름
❌ ①: 산성 거주의 비실용성 바로 뒤에 전쟁 이야기는 맥락 단절
❌ ②: 읍성의 시설 설명이 이어져야 하는 위치
❌ ③: 행정 건물 설명과 일반 백성 거주지 설명 사이에 전쟁 내용은 부자연스러움
det.tip: 평시(peaceful times) 생활 묘사 → 전시(In times of war) 대피의 대비 구조를 파악하세요.
